title: Kurmali language - Wikipedia
text: Kurmali or Kudmali is an Indo-Aryan language classified as belonging to the Bihari group of languages spoken in eastern India. As a trade dialect, it is also known as Panchpargania, for the "five parganas" of the region it covers in Jharkhand.

title: Panchpargania (NIEA) | South Asia Bibles
text: Panchpargania is an Indo-Aryan language spoken in eastern India, closely related to the Kurmali language, sometimes considered its trade dialect. It is spoken by around 194,000 people in states like Jharkhand, Odisha, and West Bengal.
